column1: # FootHoled H1 partition table — Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5B (16 MB flash)
#   0x10000 –  0x6FFFF  Factory app (6 MB)  — main FootHoled firmware
#   0x70000 –  0xCFFFF  OTA_0   (6 MB)      — OTA update slot (future signed-update support)
#   0xFE0000 – 0xFFFFFF NVS keys (128 KB)   — NVS key partition for encrypted NVS (future)
# To use this file:  platformio.ini already sets board_build.partitions = partitions.csv
# ESP-IDF:           idf.py menuconfig → Partition Table → Custom partition CSV file
#   6 MB app slots give headroom for LVGL + drivers + future radio stacks.
#   SPIFFS region provides ~13 MB for observation storage before an SD card is added.
#   Adjust OTA slot to 0 KB and redistribute to SPIFFS if OTA is never needed.
# TODO(HW): verify offset alignment on physical board after first flash.
